consequence.statement: This adds a read-only status subresource field. The operator only fills it in when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled, and existing PrometheusRule specs keep working without changes.

assertion.statement: The monitoring.coreos.com/v1 PrometheusRule CRD schema adds a read-only `status` field (with status.bindings[] and their conditions). The status is still under active development and is only updated when the "StatusForConfigurationResources" feature gate is enabled.
